title: Pilot STUDY to Monitor Ex-vivo the Biological Effects of the C3 Inhibitor, PEGCETACOPLAN, on Activation of Complement in Fluid Phase and on Podocytes in Patients With C3G and Primary IC-MPGN
official: Pilot STUDY to Monitor Ex-vivo the Biological Effects of the C3 Inhibitor, PEGCETACOPLAN, on Activation of Complement in Fluid Phase and on Podocytes in Patients With C3G and Primary IC-MPGN
summary:
This is a prospective, multicenter, non-interventional, observational pharmacological real-world study to characterize longitudinal changes in ex vivo biomarkers of complement activation in patients with C3G and primary IC-MPGN receiving pegcetacoplan in routine clinical practice.

The study will involving fifteen adult and adolescent patients who will undergo serial collection of biological samples for ex vivo assessment of complement biomarkers at time points that coincide, whenever possible, with routine clinical visits and blood sampling performed as part of standard patient management.
criteria:
Patients inclusion criteria:

1. Age ≥ 12 years
2. Willing to provide written informed consent to this study (by parents or tutors if underage)
3. Must have clinical and pathologic evidence of native kidney or recurrent C3G/IC-MPGN, as evidenced by all of the following:

   1. C3G or IC-MPGN confirmed by renal biopsy (native kidney or kidney graft), with at least 2+ staining for C3c.
   2. Clinical evidence of C3G or IC-MPGN in the form of at least 1 g/day of proteinuria in a 24-hour urine collection without other concomitant causes.
   3. C3G or IC-MPGN must be primary and not secondary to another condition (eg, infection, malignancy, monoclonal gammopathy, autoimmunity, chronic antibody-mediated rejection, chronic thrombotic microangiopathy, or a medication).

      4\) The patient is planned to initiate pegcetacoplan therapy as part of routine clinical practice (The decision to initiate pegcetacoplan treatment has been made by the treating physician according to routine clinical practice, independently of study participation).

      Patients exclusion criteria:
      1. Inability to understand the potential risks and benefits of the study
      2. Legal incapacity;
      3. Patients treated with any anti-complement therapy within one month prior to baseline sample collection

      Healthy volunteers Inclusion criteria:
      * Male and female age \> 18 years;
      * Availability of written informed consent for biobank sample storage and use

      Healthy volunteers exclusion criteria:
      * History of renal diseases, autoimmune or coagulation disorders, diabetes mellitus, current allergies
      * Participants who have taken antibiotics, anti-inflammatory drugs, or antihistamines within the past 7 days
